notes.title: Devlog #2 - Tools in the game
notes.content:
Dear Entrepreneurs,

How have you been? Hopefully, all is well with you and, just as we, you can't for new devlogs!
And so, we bring one to you today. 🙂

In this instalment we focus somewhat on the[b] tools[/b] that will allow the player to restore old buildings to a usable state (and perhaps even their former glory 😉 ).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551979/629e121a8fd2de92023164f96a92d0b52a19d461.jpg[/img]
[i]conceptart[/i]

[b]As we get to work and select our first jobs, we'll need to bring along some basic tools such as the:[/b]
[b]- hammer,
- drill,
- paint roller,
- broom,
- and spackle.[/b]

It might not seem like much for a start, but if you take into account the small size of the beginner venues, it'll be more than enough. Thanks to these implements the player will be able to create a brand new interior – set up the furnishing and product shelves as well as engage in some minor repairs. It will also be the perfect opportunity to get used to the game's keybinds. And as we well know, that's always the kind of practice pays off in the later stages of a game.

Of course with the coming of bigger shopping centers the player faces more challenges and obtains new types of equipment that helps to meet these challenges.
We're planning to include in the gameplay bigger devices that accommodate greater surfaces.
Among those will be the [b]paint gun[/b] or the [b]floor cleaning machine[/b] that will allow for efficient tidying of halls and food courts.



As always, we're open to all your suggestions for the game. We want it to meet all of your expectations. We eagerly await suggestions you submit here on Steam and on our Discord!


[b]You can receive a unique role there in our #roles channel! By choosing this reaction – 🛒 – you'll be updated regularly on all developments in Shopping Mall! Join and receive your unique role today![/b]

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Buildings
notes.content:
Dear Entrepreneurs,

As per convention, we'd like to thank you so much for all the questions coming to us from you after our previous devlog. We've found numerous fascinating ideas among them, which gives us a solid energy boost for our continued work. 🙂

This week we invite you to a broader discussion of the buildings that we'll be looking after while playing Shopping Mall Renovator.

As is often the case in life, the player begins with a modest capital, earned during recent years of work.
The catalogue of buildings available for purchase, which we are going to, naturally, describe in greater detail soon, will contain the first small jobs that will be used to prepare the player for greater challenges.

[b]The first[/b] venues on offer will be small, detached shops or slightly more spacious single-story store halls featuring a few boutiques, each of these will be required to have a functional toilet and a small snack & drink stand.
This will allow the player to get acquainted with all the game's tools, key binds, and gameplay rules of having our work evaluated by potential customers.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551979/c3cea01b2cfe448f6cf64bb988e643dab4d4bc85.jpg[/img]
[i]conceptart[/i]


Afterwards, new, and bigger buildings will appear. Shopping centers are going to sport a considerable surface area, so renovating them will require that you keep several details in mind. Some building features will become available only after achieving a specific surface size.

[b]These will include:

– escalators,
- elevators,
- underground parking,
- bigger markets,
- food courts,
- children's play areas,
- entertainment areas,
- cinemas and many more 🙂[/b]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551979/7f53c01f72f799259a359a65f9c1528a21241beb.jpg[/img]
[i]conceptart[/i]


As you can see, there's no shortage of work!
We hope our perspective on this type of buildings has earned your curiosity and will prompt further questions and suggestions. Your opinions are exceptionally relevant to us.


[b]And that's not all! 👉 Now you can choose a unique server role on the #roles channel! By choosing this reaction 🛒 you will be up to date with the news from the development of the Shopping Center! Join our discord and get a unique role! 

 : https://discord.gg/fuySh5TXsK
[/b]

All the best,
Hyper Studio
